title: OutBrick: Slide Block Puzzle
summary: A beautiful slide block puzzle game: 2,376 brain-teasing levels in 198 villages. Slide bricks to their color gates. No timer, plays offline, full VoiceOver support. OutBrick is a beautiful slide block puzzle game: slide each brick along its lane and out through the gate of its color. 2,376 hand-tuned puzzle levels across 198 toy-brick villages make a calm, clever brain teaser that trains your logic, planning and memory, with no timer and every level playable offline. If you enjoy block jam, unblock, color sort, parking and traffic escape puzzle games, OutBrick gives you a fresh challenge on every board. HOW TO PLAY • Drag a brick and it follows your finger along its lane and glides around corners. One drag is one move. • Guide each brick to the gate of its own color and watch it leave the board. • Long, tall, L and T-shaped bricks move as one piece and need a gate wide enough to let them through. • Some gates start frozen behind frosted glass. Each shows a countdown of bricks: clear that many and it thaws to reveal its color. • Every board has a move budget instead of a clock, so you can stop, think and plan at your own pace. A REAL LOGIC PUZZLE CHALLENGE Which brick goes first? Which gate opens next? Every board is packed full, and the move budget is tight, so every drag counts. New pieces keep arriving as you travel: sealed bricks, lifts, key gates, crates, chains, dispensers, pistons, garages, arrow bricks, hedges, jelly, boulders, bumpers, rails, mirror twins and more. Hard, Super Hard and Boss levels wear their own colors when you want a true test. HELPERS FOR TOUGH BOARDS Bombs, rockets and the rainbow burst bricks of any shape to open a crowded board. The UFO thaws a frozen gate or opens a sealed brick, hints point to a good next move, and undo takes one back. QUICK PLAY Clear a level and the next one slides in at once with a smooth animation and a gentle haptic, so a good run keeps its momentum. The friends celebrate with you at the end of each village. A JOURNEY MAP FULL OF LIFE Follow the road from Garden City through farms, seaside towns, snowy peaks, Haunted Hollow and thirty frontier villages, from Builder's Brickyard to Jigsaw Junction. Each village is built stud by stud with its own scenery, landmark and signature board shape. Earn stars, open village gifts and climb each village's star ladder. MEET FIVE BRICK FRIENDS Pix, Luna, Brix, Nova and Max travel the road with you. On devices with Apple Intelligence, your friend shares short tips and cheers about your board, written on your device. LIVE GAMES AND REWARDS • Village Race and Crew Race: clear new levels before the other racers. • Brick Royale: stay in the round and share the prize pot. • Friend Rescue, the Stamp Card, Brick Cinema and the Brick Wheel. • Weekly Missions, the Brick Pass reward track, the Scoreboard and your Collection. ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN Widgets show your Journey, your races and the Brick Puzzle of the Day, a mini slide puzzle you solve right in the widget. Follow a race live on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Ask Siri to play a level, find levels in Spotlight and use Shortcuts. PLAY YOUR WAY OutBrick wears Apple's Liquid Glass design on iPhone and iPad. VoiceOver describes every brick, gate and move. Optional color shapes on bricks and gates, high contrast, a left-handed tray, hold to confirm, idle hints and calm mode are in Settings, alongside support for Larger Text, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast. Progress syncs through iCloud, and Game Center keeps your achievements and leaderboards. CLEAR ABOUT CHOICE OutBrick offers optional in-app purchases for coins, boosters, lives and extras. Lives and move budgets are part of the game. Rewarded videos are optional and always started by you: no banner ads and no automatic ads between levels. An internet connection is needed for purchases, videos and online features, never to play the levels. Optional game analytics is your choice in Settings, and declining never limits gameplay, rewards or purchases. One brick, one clever drag, one village at a time: find your next satisfying clear.

title: Accessible Virtual Machine (AVM)
summary: AVM lets you install and run Windows 11 on your Mac entirely with VoiceOver, with no sighted help. It also supports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS for ARM. Recent versions add support for USB devices and update themselves automatically. It's free and open source.

title: TurnOver
summary: TurnOver is a free, open-source screen reader for the Mac that works alongside VoiceOver. It sits in the menu bar and takes over from VoiceOver in the apps you choose, such as Mail, Safari, Terminal, and Microsoft Word. Much of its design comes from NVDA, with browse mode for web pages and email, single-letter quick navigation, find, say all, and an elements list. It also understands VoiceOver's own commands. Switch to any other app and VoiceOver comes straight back.

title: Pikomofu - Cozy Virtual Pet
summary: For everyone who loves dogs and cats. A tiny pixel dog or cat lives in a little garden on your iPhone. The sky follows the real time of day and the seasons, and your pet spends its days at its own gentle pace. I love animals more than anything, and I made this calming little app with all my heart, for everyone who loves them too. If you have ever lived with a dog or a cat, you will catch small moments that make you smile and say "they really do that!" I won't explain them. Please just give it a try, and find them yourself. - One pet is free. No ads, no subscriptions. - New friends and accessories will keep coming, always free. - Pikomofu Pass, a one-time purchase, adds Apple Watch, widgets and up to 5 pets.

title: Dozo: Pill Reminder & Tracker
summary: Dozo is a simple reminder for anyone who takes pills, vitamins or injections and doesn't want to miss a dose. Set it up for yourself, or for a parent, in a few minutes. One move from the Lock Screen When a reminder arrives, choose Taken, Skip or Snooze right in the notification, without opening the app. With VoiceOver, these are in the rotor. Every kind of schedule • Set times every day • Every 8 hours and other intervals: pick the first time, the rest follow • Certain weekdays, every few days, or cycles like 21 days on, 7 off • Weekly injections or every few weeks, with site rotation • Fixed-length courses, as-needed medications, tapering doses Hard to forget A missed dose is reminded again at the interval you choose. Today tells you clearly what's next and what's late. With Siri Say "I took my medicine in Dozo" or "What's my next medication in Dozo". For your doctor Share your history as a PDF or web page, and print your medication list. Privacy Your information stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Move to a new phone with a backup file. Easy for everyone No cluttered screens; each step asks one question. Dozo also works fully with VoiceOver, large text and Voice Control, and dose actions are available as buttons or menus and in the rotor. Free and Full Package Two active medications and all features are free. For more medications, get the Full Package with a one-time lifetime purchase or a yearly subscription. Dozo does not give medical advice; ask your doctor or pharmacist about your medication. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://forali.app/dozo-privacy/

title: DownAudible
summary: DownAudible is a MacOS app that allows you to download selected books or your entire library in the best possible quality. It also allows you to convert your books to standard M4B files, with chapters and metadata intact, and you can even convert books to M4A or MP3 with a file per chapter. If you have a folder of audible files already, DownAudible will match them to your existing library so you don't have to download them again. You can also convert existing files, freeing them to be played on any device of your choosing where those files are supported.

title: Tripod — Podcast Player
summary: Tripod is a brand new podcast app designed to make it easy to stay up to date with your favourite shows. It’s built around an inbox for new episodes and queues for what you’re listening to. Audio & Playback Tripod has integrated EQ settings, can trim silence, and balance audio levels across episodes, for the smoothest listening experience. You can skip chapters or use the transcript to jump to a specific line. It also has an innovative playback scrubber that snaps to the starts of chapters, glides over skipped chapters, and uses haptic feedback for extra precision. Inbox The inbox is where new episodes arrive and you can decide whether to keep or ignore episodes. For the shows where you listen to every episode, you can send them straight to the queue. Queues Instead of playlists you have to manually manage, Tripod has automatic queues. There’s a main queue, favourites, shorts, in-progress, and each genre gets its own queue. There’s also a special queue called Someday, which lets you keep episodes that you know you want to listen to, but you don’t need to be reminded of every time you open the app. It’s ideal for podcasts discussing books or movies that you haven’t seen yet. Innovative Controls Building on decade of experience with Obscura, my award-winning camera app, Tripod uses haptics and gestures to create delightful interactions throughout the app. Intelligence On supported devices, Tripod will use Apple Intelligence to transcribe episodes, generate chapters, and determine hosts and guests for the shows you listen to, and even recommended other shows that they’ve guested on. Appearance Every view and control in Tripod is designed to adapt its appearance to what you’re listening to, making the app feel personal and vibrant. You can also choose a tint color or make the whole app monochrome if you prefer. There’s also a few app icon choices to best fit your Home Screen. Apple Watch Tripod has an Apple Watch companion app that lets you control what you listen to, skip chapters and change audio settings. Handy, or should I say… wristy? CarPlay Tripod also has a CarPlay app so you can drive safe while listening to what moves you. Well the car moves you. But art can also move you. Are podcasts not art? Who is to say. Shortcuts & Intents For the automation sickos, Tripod has actions for controlling playback and audio settings, getting and editing the contents of your queues and inbox, and more. Widgets Yeah. It’s got widgets too. Yeah, for your Home Screen! Spotlight Integration Quickly find your shows from anywhere on your device. Sleep Timers Time based or end of chapter or end of episode. And so much more. ———— Privacy Policy: http://benricemccarthy.com/tripod/privacy Terms of use: http://benricemccarthy.com/tripod/terms

title: Mushroom FM
summary: Mushroom FM, the Home of the Fun Guys, brings you four decades of magic Mushroom memories: music from the 50s to the 80s, presented live by a friendly team from New Zealand, Australia, Britain, South Africa, Canada and the US. Commercial-free, apart from the occasional old advert played for nostalgia. Built for VoiceOver from the start. Many of our presenters and listeners are blind or partially sighted, so every screen is designed to be quick and easy with VoiceOver, as well as for sighted listeners. LISTEN LIVE - Mushroom FM at the press of a button, with the show, the presenter and the song playing now. - Pause live radio and carry on where you left off, or go back to the start of the show. - Keeps playing with your iPhone locked, with controls on the Lock Screen and your headphones. - A sleep timer, including "end of this show". MUSHROOM ESCAPE Our old-time radio channel: drama, comedy, mystery and science fiction from the golden age of radio, from America, the BBC and beyond, scheduled by hand so your favourite series is on at the same time every week. SCHEDULE AND REMINDERS See the week's shows on both channels, and get a reminder before the shows you don't want to miss. LISTEN AGAIN Missed a show? Play recent shows again. TALK TO THE PRESENTERS Send a written or recorded message to the presenter on air, or to any of the Fun Guys. If you're on Mastodon, toot the presenter and follow what the Mushroom Crowd is saying, right in the app. AND MORE - Siri: "Play Mushroom FM" and "Play Mushroom FM Escape". - A Home Screen widget. - An Apple Watch app that plays the live stream. Mushroom FM is a licensed internet radio station.

title: Bambu Handy
summary: Remotely control your Bambu Lab 3D printers, explore MakerWorld’s vast library of free models, and print your favorite designs with one tap！ Remote Printer Control - Remotely operate the machine to start and stop printing whenever needed - Get real-time printing status and resolve errors promptly - Access to learning resources and step-by-step instructions to fix printing problems - High-resolution live view of the printing process - Automatic records of the printing process to help diagnose printing failures - Automatic timelapse video of the printing process to share with others 3D Model Discovery with MakerWorld - Explore countless creative models and enjoy high-quality printing for free - Find trendy works and customize your unique models with MakerLab - Like, collect, and print in one tap to bring your ideas to life - Interact with makers and redeem credits for Bambu products Bambu Handy is a free 3D printing platform. We are open to any feedback and suggestions. Whether you are an expert, hobbyist or newcomer, we would like to grow together with you. Contact: https://support.bambulab.com/en

title: Word Burner: Daily Chain
summary: A daily word chain against the clock. Every word starts on the last letter of the one before, and every letter you start a word with burns. Land on a burnt letter and the fire goes out. Everyone gets the same puzzle each day, and you get one scored run. Two minutes. How far can you chain? A NEW TWIST EVERY DAY The week gets harder from Monday to Sunday: • Monday, Classic: the plain rules • Tuesday, Hot letter: one letter is on fire, and words with it score triple • Wednesday, Long burn: words of seven or more letters score double • Thursday, Slow burn: start with one minute, and every word adds five seconds • Friday, Ashes: three letters start already burned • Saturday, Bonfire: every word needs five letters or more • Sunday, Inferno: Ashes and Bonfire together FEATURES • A fresh puzzle every day, the same for every player in the world • A bonus letter that comes back to life once you've played 40 letters • Daily and weekly Game Center leaderboards: today's best run, and your week added up from Monday to Sunday. Rank against everyone, or just your friends • Every twist explained in How to play, so you know what Sunday's Inferno has in store • Share your result as a card that shows your score and the shape of your round, never your words, so nobody gets spoiled • Streaks that grow every day you play • Satisfying burn effects and sound, made for quick sessions • No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone WORD BURNER PRO One purchase, no subscription: practice any twist as often as you like, replay every past daily, and see your full stats. The daily, the leaderboards, your streak and sharing are always free, and Pro never changes the scored daily.
